{{2020–21 Atlantic 10 men's basketball standings}}
The '''2020–21 Saint Joseph's Hawks basketball team''' represented [[Saint Joseph's University]] during the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Hawks, led by second-year head coach [[Billy Lange]], played their home games at [[Hagan Arena]] in [[Philadelphia|Philadelphia, Pennsylvania]] as members of the [[Atlantic 10 Conference]]. They finished the season 5-15, 3-9 in [[2020–21 Atlantic 10 Conference men's basketball season|A-10 Play]] to finish in 13th place. They defeated [[2020–21 La Salle Explorers men's basketball team|La Salle]] in the first round of the [[2021 Atlantic 10 men's basketball tournament|A-10 tournament]] before losing in the second round to [[2020–21 UMass Minutemen basketball team|UMass]].

==Previous season==
The previous season was the first season without longtime head coach, [[Phil Martelli]] since 1994. The [[2019–20 Saint Joseph's Hawks men's basketball team|Hawks]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2018–19 season]] 6–26 overall, 2–16 in A-10 play to finish in a tie for 13th place. As the No. 13 seed in the [[2020 Atlantic 10 men's basketball tournament|A-10 tournament]], they played against the No. 12 seed, [[2019–20 George Mason Patriots men's basketball team|George Mason]] in the opening round, where they lost 70–77.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Cole |first1=Damichael |title=George Mason 77, Saint Joseph's 70: St. Joe's comeback fell short in the first round of the Atlantic 10 Tournament |url=https://fusion.inquirer.com/college-sports/st-joes/saint-josephs-basketball-george-mason-score-stats-highlights-atlantic-10-tournament-20200311.html |website=Philadelphia Inquirer |access-date=December 11, 2020 |date=March 11, 2020}}</ref> Their season record-wise, was their poorest since the 1974–75 season.<ref>{{cite web |title=All-Time Men's Basketball Statistics: 1970-1979 |url=https://saintjoseph_ftp.sidearmsports.com/custompages/pdf/mbasketball/AllTimeMBBStats70s.pdf |website=Sidearm Sports |publisher=Saint Joseph's University Athletics |access-date=December 11, 2020}}</ref>
